returns.title: Insufficient funds
returns.explanation: The account did not have enough money for the debit.
returns.action: You may try again up to two more times within 180 days of the original effective date.

returns.title: Account closed
returns.explanation: The account was closed before the entry arrived.
returns.action: Ask the receiver for a new account; do not send again to this one.

returns.title: No account / unable to locate account
returns.explanation: The account number does not exist at this bank, or does not match the name.
returns.action: Check the account number and routing number with the receiver.

returns.title: Invalid account number structure
returns.explanation: The account number has the wrong format for this bank.
returns.action: Check the account number with the receiver.

returns.title: Unauthorized debit to consumer account using corporate SEC code
returns.explanation: A CCD or CTX debit went to a consumer account without the consumer's authorization.
returns.action: Use PPD/WEB/TEL with a consumer authorization, or stop debiting.

returns.title: Returned per ODFI's request
returns.explanation: Your own bank asked for this entry back.

returns.title: Authorization revoked by customer
returns.explanation: The consumer withdrew the authorization for these debits.
returns.action: Stop debiting until you have a new authorization.

returns.title: Payment stopped
returns.explanation: The receiver asked their bank to stop this payment.
returns.action: Contact the receiver; do not resend without agreement.

returns.title: Uncollected funds
returns.explanation: There was money in the account, but not yet available.
returns.action: You may try again up to two more times within 180 days of the original effective date.

returns.title: Customer advises originator is not known or not authorized
returns.explanation: The account holder says they do not know you or did not authorize this debit.
returns.action: Stop debiting; get a valid authorization first. Unauthorized returns count toward the network's return-rate limits.

returns.title: Customer advises entry not in accordance with the terms of the authorization
returns.explanation: The debit differs from what was authorized (amount, date, or other terms).
returns.action: Fix the error; a corrected entry may be sent within 60 days of the settlement date of the return.

returns.title: Account sold to another DFI
returns.explanation: The account moved to a different bank.
returns.action: Ask the receiver for the new routing and account number.

returns.title: Invalid ACH routing number
returns.explanation: The routing number is not a valid ACH participant.

returns.title: Representative payee deceased or unable to continue
returns.explanation: The representative payee died or can no longer act.
returns.action: Stop the payments and contact the beneficiary's representative.

returns.title: Beneficiary or account holder deceased
returns.explanation: The account holder has died.
returns.action: Stop the payments. The date of death may be in the return addenda.

returns.title: Account frozen / entry returned per OFAC instruction
returns.explanation: The account is frozen, or the entry was returned under a sanctions instruction.
returns.action: Do not resend; contact the receiver.

returns.title: File record edit criteria / questionable entry
returns.explanation: A field could not be processed, or the bank considered the entry suspicious.
returns.action: Check the entry fields; if fraud is suspected, investigate.

returns.title: Improper effective entry date
returns.explanation: The effective date was not acceptable.

returns.title: Amount field error
returns.explanation: The amount is invalid (for example zero, or not zero for a prenote).

returns.title: Non-transaction account
returns.explanation: The account does not allow this kind of transaction.
returns.action: Ask the receiver for a different account.

returns.title: Invalid company identification
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank did not accept the company identification.
returns.action: Check the company identification in the batch header.

returns.title: Invalid individual ID number
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank did not accept the individual ID number.
returns.action: Check the identification number of the entry.

returns.title: Credit entry refused by receiver
returns.explanation: The receiver refused the credit.

returns.title: Duplicate entry
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank believes this entry was already sent.
returns.action: Check whether you sent it twice before resending.

returns.title: Addenda error
returns.explanation: The addenda record was wrong or missing.

returns.title: Mandatory field error
returns.explanation: A required field was missing or wrong.

returns.title: Trace number error
returns.explanation: The trace number of the original entry was wrong.

returns.title: Routing number check digit error
returns.explanation: The check digit of the routing number is wrong.

returns.title: Corporate customer advises not authorized
returns.explanation: The business account holder says this debit was not authorized.
returns.action: Stop debiting; get a valid authorization first.

returns.title: RDFI not participant in check truncation program
Permissible return entry (CCD and CTX only)
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank returned the entry late, with your agreement.

returns.title: RDFI non-settlement
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank could not settle the entry.

returns.title: Limited participation DFI
returns.explanation: The receiver's bank may not receive this kind of entry.
returns.action: Use a different account or payment method.

returns.title: Return of improper debit entry
returns.explanation: Debits are not allowed for this SEC code or account.

returns.title: Return of improper credit entry
returns.explanation: Credits are not allowed for this SEC code.

returns.title: Source document presented for payment
returns.explanation: The check was also presented as a paper item.

returns.title: Improper source document / source document presented for payment
Return of ENR entry by federal government agency
Invalid individual ID number / identification number (ENR)
Item related to RCK entry is ineligible or RCK entry is improper
Stop payment on item related to RCK entry
Item and RCK entry presented for payment
Misrouted return
returns.explanation: A return was sent to the wrong bank.

returns.title: Return of erroneous or reversing debit
Duplicate return
returns.explanation: The return was sent twice.

returns.title: Untimely return
returns.explanation: The return was sent after the deadline.

returns.title: Field error(s)
returns.explanation: The return had wrong fields.

returns.title: Permissible return entry not accepted / return not requested by ODFI
Foreign receiving DFI unable to settle
Incorrectly coded outbound international payment
returns.explanation: The payment should have been sent as IAT.

changes.title: Incorrect routing number and account number
Incorrect individual name / receiving company name
Incorrect account number and transaction code
Incorrect routing number, account number and transaction code
Incorrect company name and company identification
Incorrect SEC code for outbound international payment

noc_action: Update your records with the corrected data before the next entry to this account (the rules give at least six banking days). The entry itself was posted.
